notes: Sarasate's opus list is mostly consistent. The main factual error is the opus number of the 'Adiós montañas mías' Zortzico. IMSLP gives it as Op. 37, which leaves Op. 39 (Zortzico de Iparraguirre, N29) as a separate work rather than a duplicate. Levels track exam evidence reasonably: Playera and Malagueña are lowest, Zapateado, Carmen and Airs écossais highest. The queued opera fantasies and late jotas are left at their proposed levels. I did not change the Op. 13 Faust duration (13 min against IMSLP's 5) because I can't verify it; it may be worth checking.

fixes.reason: IMSLP lists this Zortzico as Op. 37; Op. 39 is the Zortzico de Iparraguirre.
Single-movement showpiece rather than a concerto, so the piano-reduction label is wrong.
